title: Your First Weekend at Hobart William Smith Colleges, Shared as Cards
description: A calm, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence that moves from campus orientation points to the lakefront and downtown Geneva.

cards.title: Start at the lake
cards.subtitle: Friday morning • HWS lakefront
cards.notes: Take a quiet first walk along the HWS lakefront and orient yourself to Seneca Lake before the weekend schedule fills up.
cards.short_summary: A low-key beginning beside the lake that frames the campus setting.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies Seneca Lake as a defining part of its lakefront campus, and First Year Mentors specifically recommend watching sunrise by the lake.
cards.source_title: First Year Mentors | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Use established campus lakefront areas and follow posted shoreline guidance.

cards.title: Find the involvement desk
cards.subtitle: Friday morning • Scandling Center
cards.notes: Stop by Student Engagement with one interest in mind—clubs, events, leadership, or housing—and ask what is open this week.
cards.short_summary: A practical starting point for turning a campus interest into an activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Engagement Center in the Scandling Center helps students get involved, start clubs, plan events, and find leadership opportunities.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Center | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Office hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; check the office before making a special trip.

cards.title: Share a Saga meal
cards.subtitle: Friday lunch • Scandling Center
cards.notes: Meet a hallmate for lunch, then take a lap through the stations so dietary and grab-and-go options are easier to find later.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward shared meal at HWS’s main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS calls Saga its main dining hall and locates it inside the Scandling Center, with vegan, vegetarian, allergen-friendly, and grab-and-go stations.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and hours may vary; consult current HWS dining information.

cards.title: Cross the Quad
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • central campus
cards.notes: Use the Hobart Quadrangle as a walking checkpoint: notice the academic buildings around it and choose one place to revisit during the week.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus pause for learning the layout on foot.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS’s campus map lists the Hobart Quadrangle as a campus facility.
cards.source_title: Hobart and William Smith Colleges Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use open paths and respect any event setup or posted restrictions.

cards.title: Set up a library base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Pulteney Street
cards.notes: Find the circulation desk and a study seat, then save the library’s hours before your first assignment or group meeting needs a home.
cards.short_summary: An early campus-navigation stop that pays off once coursework begins.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists Warren Hunting Smith Library as a library on Pulteney Street and publishes its facility hours.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and until 1 a.m. Sunday; hours can change during breaks and peak periods.

cards.title: Try the recreation center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • HWS campus
cards.notes: Bring athletic shoes and choose a low-pressure first visit: walk through, ask about recreation options, or join a scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A movement-focused stop with weekend hours published by HWS.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS publishes facility hours for the Sport and Recreation Center, including weekend hours.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Published weekend hours are 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; confirm the schedule and any activity requirements before going.

cards.title: Visit St. John’s Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • HWS campus
cards.notes: Add the chapel to your walking route and, if it fits your interests, check the Spiritual Engagement schedule for an open gathering.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark with scheduled spiritual-life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS’s campus map lists St. John’s Chapel/St. Mark’s Tower, and its facilities page lists recurring worship gatherings there.
cards.source_title: Facility Hours | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: The posted schedule includes Sunday Roman Catholic Mass and Holy Eucharist; participation is optional and schedules may change.

cards.title: Look for student art
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Houghton House estate
cards.notes: Walk to Houghton House and check whether the Davis Gallery has an exhibition or open hours before planning a return visit.
cards.short_summary: An arts-oriented campus stop linked to Houghton House and student work.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies the Davis Gallery in Houghton House as part of the Houghton House estate alongside its art and architecture facilities.
cards.access_notes: Gallery exhibitions and public access vary; verify current exhibition details before visiting.

cards.title: Walk Geneva’s lakefront
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Lake Street, Geneva
cards.notes: Head downtown for the boardwalk and walking paths, pausing at the lake edge rather than treating the visit as a rushed destination.
cards.short_summary: A city-maintained waterfront walk with paths, benches, and views of Seneca Lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Geneva lists Lakefront Park on Lake Street with walking paths, benches, nature areas, and a playground.
cards.source_title: Lakefront Park | City of Geneva, NY
cards.access_notes: City facility amenities include walking paths and restrooms; follow posted park rules and conditions.

cards.title: Check the Smith calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • 82 Seneca Street, Geneva
cards.notes: Look over the Smith’s public event calendar with friends and choose a future film, performance, or history tour that suits your budget.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts venue with public performances, films, and other events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smith Opera House hosts public live theatre, concerts, community gatherings, and movie screenings in Geneva.
cards.access_notes: Event admission and timing vary; use the official calendar and ticket page for the specific program.
